role_source: OpenDota dotaconstants bf193a550f778dec35debf4d71d05a86bebcc418; descriptive role labels, not matchup ratings
hero_summary_zh: 大地之灵能使众敌乱成一团，战友斗志昂扬。无论战情如何，他都可以来回发动他的残像，对敌人造成伤害，或者将盟友从鬼门关的边缘抓回来。
hero_summary_en: Earth Spirit keeps the enemy in chaos and his friends in the fight. Adapting to any battle scenario, he can send his statue remnants back and forth to damage foes, or grips an ally from the jaws of death.

abilities.name: earth_spirit_boulder_smash
abilities.description_zh: 大地之灵将敌方单位或友方单位作为目标，将其击飞，目标将沿他面朝的方向飞行一段距离。如果大地之灵点地为目标，他将击飞%remnant_smash_radius_tooltip%范围内距离最近的单位，优先以残岩为目标。击飞的单位或残岩会对碰到的所有单位造成伤害。如果敌人是被残岩击中还将额外被减速。残岩被击飞的距离比其他单位更远。
abilities.description_en: Earth Spirit smashes the target enemy or ally, sending them in the direction he is facing. If Earth Spirit targets an area, he will smash the nearest unit in a %remnant_smash_radius_tooltip% radius, prioritizing Stone Remnants. The travelling unit or Remnant damages all enemy units it hits.  If an enemy is hit by a Stone Remnant, they are also slowed. Stone Remnants travel further than other units.

abilities.name: earth_spirit_rolling_boulder
abilities.description_zh: 大地之灵化身为巨石，经过%delay%秒延迟后向目标位置翻滚，对经过的敌人造成伤害和眩晕，伤害值为%damage% + %damage_str%%%力量。如果撞到敌方英雄或自身被眩晕，翻滚都会中止。如果翻滚过程中经过残岩将会大幅提高翻滚距离和速度，造成的眩晕时间更长。
abilities.description_en: Earth Spirit gathers himself into a boulder and, after a %delay%s delay, rolls toward the target location, dealing %damage% + %damage_str%%% STR damage and stunning enemy units. He will stop if he collides with an enemy hero or is stunned. If he rolls over a Stone Remnant, he will travel further and faster, and stun enemies for longer.
notes_zh: 翻滚时经过残岩会将其摧毁。
大地之灵在滚动时无法作为目标，而且无敌。
notes_en: Rolling over a Stone Remnant will destroy the Remnant.
The boulder has a radius of %radius%.
Earth Spirit is untargetable and invulnerable while rolling.
facet_text_en: Stone Remnants are not destroyed when rolled over, and the cooldown of Stone Remnant is refreshed when the roll is done.

Rolling over an allied hero grants the allied hero and Earth Spirit %allied_bonus_movespeed%%% bonus movespeed for %allied_bonus_movespeed_duration%s. If he rolls over an allied hero, Earth Spirit will travel further and faster, and stun enemies for longer,
facet_text_zh: 残岩在翻滚时经过不会被摧毁，而且翻滚结束后残岩的冷却时间会重置。
滚过一名友方英雄后会使该友方英雄和大地之灵获得%allied_bonus_movespeed%%%移动速度加成，持续%allied_bonus_movespeed_duration%秒。而且滚过友方英雄时，大地之灵滚动的距离变远，速度变快，<font color='#2dd5e4'>眩晕</font>敌人的时间也变长。

abilities.name: earth_spirit_geomagnetic_grip
abilities.description_zh: 大地之灵将目标残岩或友方单位拉扯到自己所在的位置，行进路径上被击中的敌人都会被沉默并受到伤害。拉扯的残岩也会对击中的敌人造成伤害。以友军为目标时施法距离减少。
abilities.description_en: Earth Spirit pulls the target Stone Remnant or Allied Unit. Enemies struck by the gripped target will be silenced.Pulled Remnants also deal damage to struck enemies.Cast range is reduced when targeting an ally.
notes_zh: 如果目标处于时间结界，决斗或黑洞之中则不起作用。
地磁之握还可以对友方小兵施放。
notes_en: Will not work on a unit inside Chronosphere, Duel, or Black Hole.
Geomagnetic Grip can also target allied creeps.

shard_loc.en: Decreases cooldown to %AbilityCooldown%s and increases allied unit cast range and pull speed.
shard_loc.zh: 冷却时间减少至%AbilityCooldown%秒，对友方单位的施法距离和牵引速度提升。

abilities.name: earth_spirit_stone_caller
abilities.description_zh: 在指定位置召唤一块残岩。残岩没有视野，为无敌状态，可以加强大地之灵的技能效果。召唤残岩需要消耗一点能量点数，能量点数会随时间恢复。残岩拥有%AbilityCharges%点能量点数。每点未使用的残岩能量都会使大地之灵被动获得%attack_damage_per_stone%%%攻击力加成，并且技能用过残岩后会额外获得%attack_damage_per_stone_used%%%攻击力加成，持续%buff_duration%秒（无法叠加）。
abilities.description_en: Call a Stone Remnant to the target location.  Stone Remnants have no vision and are invulnerable, and can be used with Earth Spirit's abilities.  Calling a Stone Remnant consumes a charge, which recharge over time. Stone Remnant has %AbilityCharges% charges.Earth Spirit passively gains %attack_damage_per_stone%%% bonus damage per unused Stone Remnant charge, and gains an additional %attack_damage_per_stone_used%%% bonus damage for %buff_duration%s when a Stone Remnant is targeted with an ability (does not stack).
facet_text_en: Has a fixed cooldown instead of charges.
facet_text_zh: 拥有固定的冷却时间，而不是能量点数。

abilities.name: earth_spirit_petrify
abilities.description_zh: 大地之灵对一名英雄施法，使其暂时获得残岩的属性。经过短时间后残岩就会碎裂，释放出英雄，并对周围单位造成伤害。可以对残岩施放。对残岩施放时冷却时间为5秒。对友方英雄施放时施法距离更远。
abilities.description_en: Earth Spirit temporarily enchants a hero, granting them the properties of a Stone Remnant. After a short duration the remnant shatters, releasing the hero and damaging nearby enemies. Can be cast on Stone Remnants. Has a 5 second cooldown when used that way.Has a larger cast range when cast on an ally hero.
notes_zh: 如果大地之灵自身受到残岩魔咒的效果，也可以成为巨石冲击的目标。
notes_en: Earth Spirit himself can be targeted by Boulder Smash if he is enchanted.

abilities.name: earth_spirit_magnetize
abilities.description_zh: 将附近小范围内的敌方单位磁化，使其短时间内受到伤害。被磁化的英雄单位将会引起附近残岩的爆炸，每次爆炸都将摧毁残岩并刷新残岩附近单位身上的磁化时间（若附近单位未被磁化则为其施加一个磁化效果）。该过程可重复数次。如果一个被磁化的英雄受到了地磁之握或巨石冲击的作用，那么所有被磁化的英雄都会受到同样效果。
abilities.description_en: Magnetizes units in a small nearby area, causing them to take damage for a short duration. Magnetized heroes cause nearby Stone Remnants to explode, destroying the remnant and refreshing Magnetize's duration on all nearby enemies. This process can repeat multiple times. If an enemy hero is affected by Geomagnetic Grip or Boulder Smash, all magnetized heroes share the effects.
facet_text_en: Magnetizing a Stone Remnant gives Earth Spirit bonus attack damage for %magnetized_rocks_buff_self_duration% seconds. Does not stack.
facet_text_zh: 磁化一个残岩会让大地之灵获得攻击力加成，持续%magnetized_rocks_buff_self_duration%秒。不会叠加。

talents_raw.name: special_bonus_unique_earth_spirit_2
talents_raw.desc_loc: Applies Magnetize at its current duration to enemy Heroes around Earth Spirit, and can be refreshed with Stone Remnants.
